nodes.description: address public owner (Ownable): privileged address; set to msg.sender in Ownable() and in the quaker constructor.
uint256 public totalSupply (quaker): initialized to INITIAL_SUPPLY * 10 ** 18; mutated by mint/pullBack and read by the totalSupply() getter.
mapping(address => uint256) tokenBalances: internal ledger written by transfer, transferFrom, transferOwnership-era constructor, mint, pullBack.
string public constant name = "quaker".
string public constant symbol = "QUA".
uint256 public constant decimals = 18.
uint256 public constant INITIAL_SUPPLY = 10000000; multiplied by 10 ** 18 without overflow checking.
address ownerWallet: wallet passed to the constructor that receives the entire initial supply.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) allowed: ERC20 allowance table written by approve/increaseApproval/decreaseApproval, spent by transferFrom and read by allowance().
constructor quaker(address wallet): assigns owner, ownerWallet, mints INITIAL_SUPPLY * 10 ** 18 to wallet (no overflow check).
transfer(address _to, uint256 _value) public: debits msg.sender and credits _to using SafeMath sub/add, then emits Transfer.
transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value) public: spends allowed[_from][msg.sender] and moves balances; no zero-address check on _from.
approve(address _spender, uint256 _value) public: overwrites allowed[msg.sender][_spender], classic allowance race condition.
totalSupply() constant returns (uint): returns totalSupply - tokenBalances[address(0)], an unchecked subtraction shadowing the state variable of the same name.
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) constant returns remaining allowance from allowed mapping.
increaseApproval(address _spender, uint _addedValue) public: adds to allowed[msg.sender][_spender] via SafeMath.add.
decreaseApproval(address _spender, uint _subtractedValue) public: reads oldValue, sets 0 if subtraction exceeds it, otherwise SafeMath.sub.
function () public payable { revert(); } — rejects plain ETH transfers.
balanceOf(address _owner) constant public returns the tokenBalances entry of _owner.
mint(address wallet, address buyer, uint256 tokenAmount) public onlyOwner: moves balances from seller to buyer but DECREASES totalSupply (totalSupply.sub), an inverted-supply logic bug.
pullBack(address wallet, address buyer, uint256 tokenAmount) public onlyOwner: moves tokens back from buyer to wallet and INCREASES totalSupply (totalSupply.add).
showMyTokenBalance(address addr) public view returns the raw tokenBalances[addr].
transferOwnership(address newOwner) onlyOwner public: reassigns owner after a zero-address require.
modifier onlyOwner: require(msg.sender == owner); applied to mint, pullBack and transferOwnership.
SafeMath.add(uint256 a, uint256 b): c = a + b with assert(c >= a).
SafeMath.sub(uint256 a, uint256 b): assert(b <= a); returns a - b.
msg.sender: attacker-controlled address used as owner, as balance/allowance key and as the onlyOwner comparison subject. tx.origin and block.timestamp are never referenced in this code.
Arithmetic in constructor: INITIAL_SUPPLY * 10 ** 18 executes inside a 0.4.18 unchecked block (overflow would silently wrap).
Arithmetic in totalSupply(): `totalSupply - tokenBalances[address(0)]` is an unchecked subtraction that can underflow/revert and whose identifier shadows the state variable.
Arithmetic in transfer(): tokenBalances[msg.sender].sub(_value) and tokenBalances[_to].add(_value) mutate the ledger.
Arithmetic in transferFrom(): balances and allowed[_from][msg.sender] are decremented/incremented.
Arithmetic in increaseApproval(): unbounded SafeMath.add on the allowance entry.
Arithmetic in decreaseApproval(): branch that zeroes the allowance or applies SafeMath.sub on oldValue.
Arithmetic in mint(): totalSupply = totalSupply.sub(tokenAmount) — supply shrinks when tokens are sold (inverted accounting).
Arithmetic in pullBack(): totalSupply = totalSupply.add(tokenAmount) — supply grows when tokens are returned.
Access-control gate on mint(): onlyOwner protects arbitrary balance rewrites of any wallet/buyer pair.
Access-control gate on pullBack(): onlyOwner may seize tokens from any buyer back to any wallet.
Access-control gate on transferOwnership(): onlyOwner can hand over the privileged owner role.
Access-control check require(msg.sender == owner) inside the onlyOwner modifier.
Access-control/front-running weakness: approve() overwrites the allowance, allowing a spender to spend both old and new allowance.

edges.reason: msg.sender is written into the owner state variable by the Ownable constructor and again by the quaker constructor, making the deployer the privileged account.
Constructor body sets owner directly, duplicating the inherited Ownable ownership assignment.
Constructor assigns ownerWallet from the supplied wallet argument.
Constructor parameter wallet flows into the ownerWallet state variable.
Constructor parameter wallet is used as the key credited in tokenBalances.
totalSupply is initialized as INITIAL_SUPPLY * 10 ** 18 without any overflow protection (0.4.18 unchecked arithmetic).
Constructor credits the entire initial supply into tokenBalances[wallet].
Constructor execution reaches the multiplication INITIAL_SUPPLY * 10 ** 18.
Caller-controlled msg.sender selects which balance is debited in transfer().
transfer() rewrites two entries of the tokenBalances ledger.
transfer() executes the balance subtraction/addition arithmetic sink.
transfer parameter _to is used as the credited tokenBalances key.
transfer parameter _value drives the balance addition/subtraction amounts.
transferFrom() checks and spends allowed[_from][msg.sender], so the caller's allowance is authoritative.
transferFrom() reads and decrements the allowed mapping entry of the caller.
transferFrom() rewrites tokenBalances[_from] and tokenBalances[_to].
transferFrom() executes the allowance and balance arithmetic sink.
transferFrom parameter _value is subtracted from the caller's allowance entry.
transferFrom parameter _from selects the debited tokenBalances key.
transferFrom parameter _to selects the credited tokenBalances key.
approve() writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender] for the calling account.
approve() overwrites the caller's allowance entry with the new value.
approve() reaches the allowance-overwrite race condition sink.
totalSupply() getter reads the totalSupply state variable, whose name it shadows.
totalSupply() getter reads tokenBalances[address(0)] to offset the supply.
totalSupply() getter executes the unchecked `totalSupply - tokenBalances[address(0)]` subtraction.
allowance() reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
The allowance mapping value is returned through the local remaining variable.
increaseApproval() increases allowed[msg.sender][_spender] for the caller.
increaseApproval() rewrites the caller's allowance entry.
increaseApproval() executes the unbounded allowance addition sink.
decreaseApproval() rewrites the caller's allowance entry (zeroed or subtracted).
decreaseApproval() executes the allowance subtraction sink.
Local oldValue caches allowed[msg.sender][_spender] before modification.
oldValue is the left operand of the allowance subtraction in decreaseApproval.
balanceOf() reads tokenBalances[_owner].
The ledger value is returned through the local balance variable.
mint() credits buyer and debits wallet in the tokenBalances ledger.
mint() mutates the totalSupply state variable in the wrong direction.
mint() reaches totalSupply.sub(tokenAmount), which reduces supply while tokens are sold.
mint() is protected by the onlyOwner privilege gate on arbitrary balance rewrites.
mint parameter tokenAmount is the amount added to buyer and subtracted from wallet.
onlyOwner modifier gates execution of mint().
pullBack() debits buyer and credits wallet in the tokenBalances ledger.
pullBack() increases the totalSupply state variable.
pullBack() reaches totalSupply.add(tokenAmount), which inflates supply when tokens are returned.
pullBack() is protected by the onlyOwner privilege gate that can seize any buyer's tokens.
pullBack parameter tokenAmount is the amount moved between buyer and wallet balances.
onlyOwner modifier gates execution of pullBack().
showMyTokenBalance() reads tokenBalances[addr].
Parameter addr selects the ledger entry read by showMyTokenBalance.
transferOwnership() reassigns the privileged owner state variable.
transferOwnership() reaches the ownership-transfer privilege sink.
onlyOwner modifier gates execution of transferOwnership().
Parameter newOwner becomes the new owner state variable.
onlyOwner modifier compares the untrusted msg.sender against owner.
onlyOwner modifier reads the owner state variable as the authorization reference.
onlyOwner modifier reaches the require(msg.sender == owner) authorization check.
SafeMath.add left operand a flows into the addition.
SafeMath.add right operand b flows into the addition.
SafeMath.add stores a + b in the local c before the assert(c >= a) guard.
SafeMath.sub left operand a flows into the subtraction.
SafeMath.sub right operand b flows into the subtraction.
SafeMath.sub computes the difference after the assert(b <= a) guard.

transfer parameter _to is only used as the credited ledger key inside transfer().
transfer parameter _value is only consumed by the balance arithmetic of transfer().
transferFrom parameter _from only selects the debited balance and allowance inside transferFrom().
transferFrom parameter _to only selects the credited balance inside transferFrom().
transferFrom parameter _value is the amount subtracted from balances and allowance by the transferFrom arithmetic.
approve parameter _spender only indexes the allowance entry written by approve().
approve parameter _value is the allowance value overwritten in the front-running-prone approve() write.
allowance() parameter tokenOwner only keys the allowance mapping read.
allowance() parameter spender only keys the allowance mapping read.
increaseApproval parameter _spender only indexes the allowance entry being increased.
increaseApproval parameter _addedValue is the operand of the allowance addition.
decreaseApproval parameter _spender only indexes the allowance entry being decreased.
decreaseApproval parameter _subtractedValue drives the branch and the allowance subtraction.
balanceOf parameter _owner only keys the tokenBalances read.
mint parameter wallet only selects the seller balance updated inside mint().
mint parameter buyer only selects the credited balance updated inside mint().
mint parameter tokenAmount is the amount moved between balances and subtracted from totalSupply.
pullBack parameter wallet only selects the balance credited inside pullBack().
pullBack parameter buyer only selects the balance debited inside pullBack().
pullBack parameter tokenAmount is the amount moved between balances and added to totalSupply.
showMyTokenBalance parameter addr only keys the tokenBalances read.
transferOwnership parameter newOwner is written straight into the owner state variable.

SafeMath.add operand b is only meaningful inside the add helper.
SafeMath.sub operand a is only meaningful inside the sub helper.
SafeMath.sub operand b is only meaningful inside the sub helper.
oldValue is a temporary cache of the allowance entry inside decreaseApproval.
